text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm passing by the fields one day, when…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Brilliant! Your skin has a most lustrous shine!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Elegant! You have a nice firm surface as well. It reflects a proper upbringing!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Oho? Why, what a coincidence! Welcome, welcome!
choice_data_list: Umm… What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Excellent question! I was just commending these fine carrots on their attributes!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Listen well! I desire to create a comfortable environment for all this academy's students. Naturally, high-quality carrots are essential!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I require carrots high in nutritional value—carrots that will make the mouth water… In other words, carrots grown with love!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indisputable! Carrots grow best when given love and encouragement, just like Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And the essence of love is respect and resolve! It requires the insight to see somebody's true nature, and the wherewithal to treat them with dignity!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: To watch over them to the end, come what may! To praise them and push them to their fullest potential!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: That is love! But perhaps a more concrete example is in order.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa squats down and pulls out a carrot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crunch!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Like so!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Delectable! This flavor is the mark of a carrot well grown. The reward of the conscientious gardener!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: My vision! I want to see every Umamusume mature as surely as these carrots.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Until that day, I'll do whatever I can to aid them on their way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa's analogy is a little hard to follow, but there's no doubting her passion.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Encouragement! Grow, my carrots! Grow strong and sturdy enough to reach the sky!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Only then will you become high-quality food for our Umamusume! Now is the time to grow, carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's clear as day that Director Akikawa sincerely cares for her students.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that sincerity is something I firmly believe deserves respect. Which leads me to say…
choice_data_list: Shall I help you with the field work?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Shocking! What a bolt from the blue!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Very well! If you are willing to help, I would be delighted!
choice_data_list: I'll start by plowing the field.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: My deepest thanks! The students and the carrots are relying on you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I raise my hoe to plow the field, and—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Ngh!)

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Ominous! What was that sound just now?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Stiff as stone! And you're sweating bullets! Don't tell me you've pulled something in your back?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Attention! There's an emergency!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Apparently, I'm not strong enough to use a hoe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, school officials rush to the scene and have to carry me away on a stretcher.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My back pain ends up lasting for days, affecting <chrname>'s training.
